summary: December 2025: IPv6 single- and dual-stack supported on OpenShift and RPM by setting FEATURE_GATEWAY_IPV6_USAGE_ENABLED true (containerized came later), and org admins can deploy an Ansible MCP server (Tech Preview) on Operator or containerized 2.6 so AI tools like Claude, Cursor or ChatGPT can query AAP and run workflows.
questions: How do I enable IPv6 in AAP 2.6?
Can I connect Claude or Cursor to Ansible Automation Platform?
What is the Ansible MCP server?
Which installs support the Ansible MCP server?

answer_card.title: Ansible MCP server (Tech Preview)
answer_card.answer_md:
- Org admins can deploy it on **Operator-based or containerized** AAP 2.6 (December 2025 patch).
- Lets external AI tools (for example Claude, Cursor, ChatGPT) query AAP and run workflows and automation with natural-language prompts.
- Technology Preview: no production SLA.
- See *Deploying an Ansible MCP server on Ansible Automation Platform*.
